headline: Sensex gains 100 points, Nifty nears 25,200 as Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens and VIX rises 6%

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex rose by 100 points while the Nifty 50 index approached the 25,200 mark in early trade
The India VIX surged by 6%, indicating an increase in market volatility expectations
Mahanadi Coalfields launched its ₹8,981 crore initial public offering (IPO) today
Three bank unions have called for a nationwide strike scheduled for December 3
whatHappening: Star Health and Sterlite Technologies are showing bullish technical patterns such as rising RSI and White Marubozu
Go Digit and PhysicsWallah shares recorded gains during the morning session
Paytm shares experienced a decline as the broader market opened flat to positive
CreditAccess Grameen is among several stocks currently trading below their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP)
summary: The Indian stock market opened with modest gains on Thursday, with the Nifty hovering near 25,200 despite a 6% jump in volatility. Investor focus is split between the massive Mahanadi Coalfields IPO and technical breakouts in stocks like Star Health and Sterlite Technologies. While Go Digit and PhysicsWallah saw early gains, Paytm shares traded lower amid news of upcoming bank strikes.
